name: v76_social_vwap_balanced_lowcorr
hypothesis: Two clean but individually weak seeds, slow social-attention normalization and VWAP/volume absorption, may combine into a stronger low-correlation signal.
expression: 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_ret_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.25 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((close - vwap) / close, 20)) + 0.10 * rank(ts_rank(volume / adv20, 20)) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (unsystematic_risk_last_60_days - unsystematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry)
notes: Fusion of 1Y7Z65JQ and pw65od6V; reject if it becomes a mL86Jle1/VWAP sibling.

name: v76_social_vwap_trade_when_calm
hypothesis: The same social/VWAP fusion may work better when refreshed only during calmer absolute-return regimes, reducing churn and drawdown.
expression: trade_when(ts_rank(abs(returns), 20) < 0.75, 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_ret_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.25 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((close - vwap) / close, 20)) + 0.10 * rank(ts_rank(volume / adv20, 20)) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_90_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 126), industry), -1)
notes: Uses proven trade_when syntax from prior DB; designed to reduce turnover, not to create a technical near-neighbor.

name: v76_social_vwap_fast_earnings_small_confirm
hypothesis: A small fast-earnings confirmation may lift the low-correlation social/VWAP basket without letting the high-correlation fast-news parent dominate.
expression: 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_ret_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.25 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((close - vwap) / close, 20)) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_bee_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_90_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: Fast earnings is only 15%; gate strictly against e7OQoveE/Vkp0P130.

name: v76_social_vwap_reported_fcf_tiny_confirm
hypothesis: A tiny reported-FCF confirmation may improve quality while keeping the parent mechanism social/VWAP rather than the occupied reported-FCF capacity.
expression: 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_ret_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.25 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((close - vwap) / close, 20)) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(free_cash_flow_reported_value / equity, 126), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Reported FCF is only 15%; reject if corr approaches P0pgZllw/9qwWXNW9.

name: v76_vwap_social_risk_dominant
hypothesis: The VWAP/volume seed may be the stronger parent if slow social relief is used only as a low-correlation stabilizer.
expression: 0.35 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((close - vwap) / close, 20)) + 0.20 * rank(ts_rank(volume / adv20, 20)) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_ret_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (unsystematic_risk_last_60_days - unsystematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry)
notes: A more technical-weighted fusion; reject if it behaves like close-location/VWAP stopped routes.
